001package dayplanner;

003
004
005/**
006 * <p>
007 * Main application class and execution entry point for DayPlanner.
008 * </p>
009 * <p>
010 * Loads the configured activity files, runs the interactive menu, and saves
011 * changes when the user quits.
012 * </p>
013 */
014public class DayPlanner {
015    private static final Input KEYBOARD = new Input();
016
017    private static final String DATA_DIRECTORY = "dat";
018    private static String dataFileName;
019    private static ActivityList activities;
020
021    private static final String USERNAME_FILENAME = "username.txt";
022    private static final String USERNAME = DayPlannerUtils.getUsername(
023        DATA_DIRECTORY,
024        USERNAME_FILENAME,
025        KEYBOARD);
026
027
028    /**
029     * Main entry point for the DayPlanner application.
030     * 
031     * @param args command-line arguments (currently unused).
032     */
033    public static void main(String[] args) {
034        // Get the data file name from args
035        if (args.length != 1) {
036            System.out.println("\nThe program has halted because you did not specify a data file name.");
037            System.out.println("A sample file named 'sampleData.ras' is included. Specify it as the first execution argument:");
038            System.out.println("\tjava -jar bin/DayPlanner.jar sampleData.ras\n");
039            return;
040        }
041        dataFileName = args[0];
042
043        // Initialize activitylist
044        try {
045            activities = new ActivityList(DATA_DIRECTORY, dataFileName);
046        } catch (Exception e) {
047            System.out.println("\nError initializing activitylist from this data file ("+dataFileName+").\n");
048            return;
049        }
050
051        // Perform the command loop until the user quits
052        boolean doLoop = true;
053        while (doLoop)
054            doLoop = commandLoop();
055
056        // The above loop only finishes when the user wants to quit
057        // Attempt to save the list in RAS format
058        boolean errors = saveToRAS();
059        if (errors)    System.out.println("\nError saving the list.");
060        else           System.out.println("\nThe list was saved successfully.");
061
062        System.out.println("\nNow quitting DayPlanner. Goodbye!");
063    }
064
065
066
067    /**
068     * Displays the main menu and processes a single user command.
069     * 
070     * @return {@code true} to show the menu again, or {@code false} after
071     *         processing quit.
072     */
073    public static boolean commandLoop() {
074        // Print a big greeting message
075        System.out.println("\n\n\t\t===-=-==-=====-==-=-===\n\n");
076        System.out.println("\t『 DAY PLANNER 』  Main Menu\n");
077        System.out.println(DayPlannerUtils.getGreeting(
078            USERNAME,
079            activities.size()));
080        System.out.println("\nPlease enter a command:");
081        System.out.println("\t1. add    - Insert a new activity");
082        System.out.println("\t2. search - Search for an activity");
083        System.out.println("\t3. quit   - Exit DayPlanner\n");
084
085        String cmd;
086        MenuOption option;
087        while (true) {
088            cmd = KEYBOARD.readCommand();
089            option = MenuOption.parse(cmd);
090
091            if (option == null) {
092                System.out.println("Invalid command: \"" + cmd + "\".");
093                System.out.println("Please enter 'add' (or 'a'), 'search' (or 's'), or 'quit' (or 'q'):");
094                continue;
095            } else {
096                break;
097            }
098        }
099
100        switch (option) {
101            case ADD    -> addActivity();
102            case SEARCH -> searchForActivity();
103            case QUIT   -> { return false; }
104            case FLUSH_USERNAME ->
105                DayPlannerUtils.flushUsername(DATA_DIRECTORY, USERNAME_FILENAME);
106        }
107
108        return true;
109    }
110
111
112
113    /**
114     * Saves the activity list to its RAS file.
115     * 
116     * @return {@code true} if the list could not be saved; {@code false}
117     *         if the list was written successfully.
118     */
119    public static boolean saveToRAS() {
120        return !activities.saveToRAS(DATA_DIRECTORY, dataFileName);
121    }
122
123
124
125    /**
126     * Prompts the user for details and adds a new activity to the appropriate list.
127     */
128    public static void addActivity() {
129        System.out.println("Let's add a new activity to the DayPlanner.");
130
131        // 1. Activity type
132        ActivityType type;
133
134        while (true) {
135            System.out.println("Enter the type of this activity.");
136            System.out.println("For Home, type 'home' or 1. For School, type 'school' or 2. For Other, type 'other' or 3:");
137            type = ActivityType.parse(KEYBOARD.readString());
138
139            if (type == null) {
140                System.out.println("Invalid activity type. Try again:");
141                continue;
142            }
143
144            break;
145        }
146
147        // 2. Title
148        String title;
149        while (true) {
150            System.out.println("Enter a title.");
151            title = KEYBOARD.readString();
152            if (!title.isEmpty())
153                break;
154            System.out.println("Title cannot be empty. Try again:");
155        }
156
157        // 3. Start time
158        System.out.println("Enter a starting time.");
159        Time startTime = KEYBOARD.readTime();
160
161        // 4. End time
162        Time endTime;
163        while (true) {
164            System.out.println("Enter an ending time.");
165            endTime = KEYBOARD.readTime();
166
167            if (startTime.compareTo(endTime) < 0)
168                break;
169
170            System.out.println("Ending time has to be after the starting time (" + startTime + "). Try again:");
171        }
172
173        // 5. Optional comment
174        System.out.println("Would you like to enter a comment?");
175        String comment = null;
176        if (KEYBOARD.readBool()) {
177            System.out.println("Enter a comment.");
178            comment = KEYBOARD.readString();
179            if (comment.isEmpty())
180                comment = null;
181        }
182
183        // 6. Location (Other activities only)
184        String location = null;
185        if (type == ActivityType.OTHER) {
186            while (true) {
187                System.out.println("Enter a location.");
188                location = KEYBOARD.readString();
189                if (!location.isEmpty())
190                    break;
191                System.out.println("Location cannot be empty for Other activities. Try again:");
192            }
193        }
194
195        // 7. Instantiate and insert activity
196        Activity act = switch (type) {
197            case HOME   -> new HomeActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
198            case SCHOOL -> new SchoolActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
199            case OTHER  -> new OtherActivity(title, startTime, endTime, comment, location);
200            default     -> new Activity(title, startTime, endTime, comment);
201        };
202
203        if (act != null) {
204            activities.add(act);
205            System.out.println("Successfully created the new activity:\n\t" + act.toString());
206        }
207    }
208

211    /**
212     * Asks which activities to look for, then displays every activity that
213     * matches the filters.
214     */
215    public static void searchForActivity() {
216        System.out.println("Let's search for activities in the DayPlanner.");
217
218        // an empty type means the search should include every activity
219        ActivityType type = null;
220        while (true) {
221            System.out.println("Enter activity type ('home', 'school', 'other'), or press Enter to search all types:");
222            String input = KEYBOARD.readString();
223            if (input.isEmpty())
224                break;
225
226            type = ActivityType.parse(input);
227            if (type != null)
228                break;
229
230            System.out.println("Invalid activity type: \"" + input + "\". Please enter 'home', 'school', 'other', or press Enter to skip:");
231        }
232
233        // FILTER BY KEYWORD
234        // if input is blank, do not restrict titles
235        // otherwise, treat each word as its own filter
236        System.out.println("Enter title keywords (separated by spaces), or press Enter to match any title:");
237        String keywordInput = KEYBOARD.readString();
238        String[] keywords = keywordInput.isEmpty()
239            ? null
240            : keywordInput.trim().split("\\s+");
241
242        // FILTER BY TIME
243        // null = unbound
244        Time[] period = DayPlannerUtils.readTimePeriod(KEYBOARD);
245        Time searchStart = period[0];
246        Time searchEnd = period[1];
247
248        int totalMatches = 0;
249        System.out.println("\nSearch results:");
250
251        for (int position : activities.findTitleMatches(keywords)) {
252            Activity activity = activities.get(position);
253            if (DayPlannerUtils.matchesCriteria(activity, type, searchStart, searchEnd)) {
254                totalMatches++;
255                System.out.println(String.format(
256                    "\t%d. %s",
257                    totalMatches,
258                    activity.toString()
259                ));
260            }
261        }
262
263        // how many activities matched?
264        if (totalMatches == 0)
265            System.out.println("\tNo activities matched your search request.");
266        else
267            System.out.println("\nTotal matched activities: " + totalMatches);
268
269        // press enter to continue
270        KEYBOARD.pressEnterToContinue();
271    }

277     */
